summary: Ming Shing Group (filer) filed Form 6-K disclosing a stock purchase agreement to acquire 100% of PMA Nano Carbon Tech Limited (BVI) for a total consideration of US$110 million, payable via unsecured convertible promissory notes convertible at US$0.99 per ordinary share, with a conversion cap of 9.99% beneficial ownership per holder. The target, through its Singapore subsidiary, focuses on graphene-based thermal management technologies. The acquisition is subject to Nasdaq approval and expected to close within one month. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The consideration structure is all-stock via convertible notes with no fixed maturity, adding overhang. Watch for Nasdaq review and the dilution profile post-conversion.
